entries.title: Stingray Facts
entries.text:
Stingrays get their name from the venomous barbs in their tail. Ouch!

Please watch those fingers! Management is not responsible for any injuries.

The Stingray's mouth and nostrils make them look like they're always happy! 

Go on, flip one over and see for yourself!

Stingrays have no bones! Oooh spooky! Where did they go?

entries.title: Starfish Facts
entries.text:
The humble Starfish is neither a fish nor a star. Huh?!

They don't have a brain and see with their legs. Weird!

They are also notorious for their ability to regenerate missing limbs. Whoa!

We ask that patrons please refrain from dismembering the Starfish.

entries.title: Horseshoe Crab Facts
entries.text:
Like the Starfish, the Horseshoe Crab is not an actual horse, shoe, or a crab! How confusing...

Did you know they also have blue blood? Gross.

Their blood is also vital to the pharmaceutical industry. How practical!

They're also much older than the dinosaurs! Neat!

entries.title: Whale Facts
entries.text:
Did you know, contrary to popular belief, whales and other sea mammals are perfectly content to live their lives in their own cozy tanks. The ocean is a very dark and scary place after all.

Did you know, one day scientists believe that we'll be able to communicate with whales? How exciting! What do you think they'd have to say?

Did you know, that researchers can tell how a Beluga Whale is feeling by examining the hormones in their snot? Yuck!

items.name: Ticking Clock
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: The last time I spoke into one of these was during an interview with a muckraker before the bombs. Ironic.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: Some nobody farmer from the outskirts of the city came knocking at my door today. Tracked his muddy boots all over City Hall.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: Said that I've done a terrible job as mayor, and it's about time someone did something about it. As if someone of his ilk could do better!

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: He told me I have two options. Either I leave and get to keep my head, or he blows it off me. I say let him try!

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: He's not the first loon to try to usurp me, that's for sure. Plenty more have tried and failed, and they had a lot more power than Timothy Lane.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: I'm not going anywhere. My security detail will make quick work of him. Maybe I'll even have Quentino's boys teach him a lesson.
